That suited our fishing business perfectly — we are highly weather-dependent and primarily take bookings in person, while potentially moving to online bookings via a website in the future. Throughout the entire setup and onboarding process, there was no mention whatsoever that we would later be told our plan was unsuitable, that we would be required to change plans, or that offline bookings would ever be subject to percentage-based fees. We were never told there was any requirement to be online or to use Rezdy for payments. We invested months setting up the system, learning the software, and integrating it into our operations. Then, three to four months in — once we were comfortable and reliant on the platform — Rezdy abruptly informed us that we had to change plans because it was supposedly more suitable for our business. When we asked to compare plans, we were pushed toward a Marketplace plan that: Is not displayed anywhere on their website Charges 3% of all bookings, online or offline Applies even though we do not take payments through Rezdy Applies even though bookings are manually entered In other words, Rezdy is now seeking a percentage of our revenue for bookings they did not generate and payments they do not process. タイトル: Avoid Rezdy - Failure to fix fundamental programming bugs

改善点: Very slow with support. Rezdy has a WHOLE CURRENCY which displays incorrectly on its system (XPF), this eliminates several whole countries from being able to make a booking, simply because their I.T. guys have failed to put in the currency conversion correctly on their Rezdy system. Rezdy has had this reported to them multiple times over a period of months, but unfortunately they don't have time to deal with even such a fundamental programming error. If they get this wrong then they could be getting a lot wrong.

タイトル: Too many missing features
投稿者: Frank スイスのOwner レジャー、旅行、観光, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Too many missing features"
良い点: Rezdy is fairly easy to use, if you have products with fixed timings (e.g. tours that start at fixed times and have fixed durations). And if you only need english as language.
改善点: There are many cons: - no native multi-language support (e.g. emails can't be configured for different languages) - rental products with open timings (means the customer can enter the start and end time) are basically unmanageable. in addition rezdy has blocked resource management for rental products, so forget it to manage your rental equipment with rezdy - email handling is very bad: you don't see emails that where sent out (just the time stamp of sending, but not the content). You can't configure own email templates, you're stuck with the fixed set of email templates that rezdy has implemented. Say you need different emails for guided tours and for rentals, or different emails for different product status (pending, confirmed etc), rezdy does not offer a solution for this - handling of feature requests is very very poor. They even closed the forum for feature requests some months ago, with no substitution as of now. If you send them a request as email, they let you down most of the times, saying "we don't have this feature" and "there is no ETA when it will be implemented", and to top this behavior, your ticket is always being marked as "Solved", with no chance for you as a customer to follow up on open requests. Rezdy seems to think that if they replied in an unsatisfying way to the customer the topic is "solved" ....
